data.title: Device Fingerprint Anomaly
data.description: Detects a known device fingerprint presenting with changed underlying characteristics such as OS version, screen resolution, timezone, or installed fonts. Attackers using antidetect browsers (Multilogin, GoLogin, Dolphin Anty) import stolen device fingerprints but often have mismatches in lower-level hardware attributes that this rule correlates.
